digest.component_or_area: CLI reference generation and distribution validation
propositions: CLI reference documentation and distribution checks must derive exclusively from registry enumeration and committed parser artifacts to eliminate drift
Manual command/usage/option census (INTERCEPT_COMMANDS, source regex parsing) must be removed and replaced with canonical registry-driven generation
All test routes and policy enumerations must use registry-derived route classes instead of hand-reconstructed route unions
Clean no-extras wheels must render every approved help form with exact committed bytes and no side effects from operation/config/store/parser/handler imports
Full-extra validation must resolve every lazy handler/parser/selector reference and validate all capability-to-extra mappings without command execution
Editorial content must be structurally separated from generated syntax sections and linted against registry spellings without overriding parser artifacts
